scripts.build: npm run build -w @ocean/shared && npm run build -w @ocean/server && npm run build -w @ocean/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ocean/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @ocean/server" "npm run dev -w @ocean/client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ocean/shared && npm run test -w @ocean/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ocean/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ocean/server && npm run typecheck -w @ocean/client
